positions.as_written: Confirm on the coronal and axial images, because the sagittal plane alone cuts the ligament obliquely and can make it disappear.
Use a proton density or intermediate weighted sequence for the fibre pattern and a fluid sensitive one for oedema.
Follow the ligament from the femoral attachment to the tibial attachment without losing it, which is what a normal reading requires.
Assess its line against the roof of the notch, because a normal ligament runs parallel to it.
- It must be followed from one attachment to the other on more than one plane.
